lines.name: Silhouette Sheer Shades
lines.summary: Silhouette shadings have soft S-shaped fabric vanes suspended between two sheer layers. Tilting the vanes changes the balance of light and privacy, and the sheer gives a softly filtered look with a view outside during the day.
features: Tilting fabric vanes for light and privacy control
UV protection for floors and furnishings
Optional Duolite or A Deux room-darkening layer and ClearView sheers

lines.name: Pirouette Window Shadings
lines.summary: Pirouette shadings use soft horizontal fabric vanes attached to a single sheer backing. The vanes open and close to change the light, and the shade looks like a soft Roman-style fabric shade when closed.
features: Soft 5-inch fabric vanes on one back sheer
Optional A Deux room-darkening roller in the same headrail
ClearView sheers and Alustra fabrics available

lines.name: Nantucket Window Shadings
lines.summary: Nantucket shadings follow the same idea as Silhouette, with S-shaped vanes between two sheers, in a more casual set of fabrics. They soften daylight and give daytime privacy.
features: Optional A Deux design adds room darkening

lines.name: Luminette Privacy Sheers
lines.summary: Luminette is a vertical sheer panel with rotating fabric vanes, combining the look of drapery with the light control of a vertical blind. It is designed for sliding doors and large windows.
features: Suited to patio doors and wide windows

lines.name: Duette Honeycomb Shades
lines.summary: Duette is Hunter Douglas's honeycomb (cellular) shade, whose air-trapping cells help insulate the window in summer and winter. Duette Architella adds a cell-within-a-cell design for extra efficiency, and vertical versions are made for doors.
features: Insulating cellular construction; Architella option for more efficiency

lines.name: Applause Honeycomb Shades
lines.summary: Applause is a more streamlined honeycomb shade with a smaller set of styles and fabrics. It uses an insulating double-cell design to help keep rooms comfortable.
features: Insulating single (3/4 inch) or double-cell pleats

lines.name: Sonnette Cellular Roller Shades
lines.summary: Sonnette pairs the look of a roller shade with a gently curved cellular fabric. The cell adds insulation and spreads light softly across the room.
features: Kickback privacy feature and front-rolling option

lines.name: Vignette Modern Roman Shades
lines.summary: Vignette is an updated Roman shade with even folds and no exposed rear cords. It comes as a rolling or stacking shade in sheer, light-filtering or room-darkening fabrics.
features: Full fold (4 inch) or flat fold (6 inch)

lines.name: Carole Fabrics Roman Shades
lines.summary: These custom fabric Roman shades are made by Carole Fabrics, a Hunter Douglas partner company, and come in several fold styles. They can be coordinated with Carole drapery and trims.
features: Flat, Front Fold, Reverse Fold, Hobbled, Slouch and Soft Roman styles

lines.name: Alustra Woven Textures Roman Shades
lines.summary: This Roman shade uses Hunter Douglas's premium Alustra woven fabrics, sourced from around the world. It has a softly structured, transitional look.

lines.name: Alustra Woven Textures Roller Shades
lines.summary: A premium roller shade made with textured Alustra woven fabrics. It is positioned as a more decorative alternative to standard roller and solar shades.
features: Choice of top and bottom treatments
Duolite and Dual Roller options for layered light control

lines.name: Alustra Architectural Roller Shades
lines.summary: Alustra Architectural is a roller shade with fabric-covered horizontal battens, giving it some of the look of a Roman shade. It has no exposed rear cords or stacked fabric.
features: Front-rolling option to clear handles and cranks

lines.name: Provenance Woven Wood Shades
lines.summary: Provenance shades are handcrafted from natural woods, reeds, grasses and bamboo. They come in several Roman styles and as vertical drapery for wide openings.
features: Roman, Waterfall Roman, Recessed Roman and Vertical Drapery styles
Materials from sheer to opaque, including Fine Weaves

lines.name: Designer Roller Shades
lines.summary: Designer Roller Shades are Hunter Douglas's core roller shade, with a large fabric range from sheer to opaque. They have a clean, simple look that suits most rooms.
features: Hundreds of fabrics, sheer to opaque
Beaded loop control for smooth operation
Duolite and Dual Roller layering options

lines.name: Designer Solar (Screen) Shades
lines.summary: These roller shades use screen fabrics that cut glare and UV while keeping the view outside. An Eco Collection uses fabrics made from recovered shoreline plastic or recycled yarns.
features: Reduces glare and UV while preserving the view

lines.name: Designer Banded Shades
lines.summary: Banded shades alternate sheer and solid fabric stripes on a continuous loop. Shifting the bands moves the shade between a filtered view and privacy.

lines.name: Parkland Wood Blinds
lines.summary: Parkland blinds are made from real wood in a wide range of stains and paint colors. The slats tilt for light control and privacy.

lines.name: EverWood Alternative Wood Blinds
lines.summary: EverWood is a faux wood blind built to handle humidity and sun, which makes it a good fit for bathrooms, kitchens and sunrooms. It is backed by Performance Plus protection against fading, warping and bowing.

lines.name: Modern Precious Metals Aluminum Blinds
lines.summary: These are durable aluminum mini blinds suited to busy, high-traffic rooms. They come in many colors and finishes.

lines.name: Skyline Gliding Window Panels
lines.summary: Skyline is a panel-track system of wide fabric panels that slide across tall or wide windows and doors. The panels stack tightly when open, and the system can also be ceiling-mounted as a room divider.
features: Can serve as a room divider

lines.name: Somner Custom Vertical Blinds
lines.summary: Somner is the broader of Hunter Douglas's two vertical blind lines, with fabric, vinyl and aluminum vanes in many colors and textures. It is aimed at sliding doors and large windows.
features: Left, right, split or center stack

lines.name: Vertical Solutions Vertical Blinds
lines.summary: Vertical Solutions is a simpler vertical blind collection with essential fabric and vinyl vanes in neutral colors. It uses the same headrail as Somner.
features: Fabric and vinyl vanes in neutral colors
Left, right, split or center stack

lines.name: Aria Soft Blinds
lines.summary: Aria is a horizontal blind made from soft, translucent fabric vanes that turn sunlight into an even glow. It suits very large windows and uses a tilt bar to adjust the vanes.
features: Soft fabric vanes in neutral colors
Tilt bar adjusts vanes without twisting

lines.name: Heritance Hardwood Shutters
lines.summary: Heritance shutters are made from 100% natural hardwood with dovetail construction. They come painted or stained, including custom colors.
features: Solid hardwood with Truemill dovetail construction
20+ finishes plus custom paints and stains
Shapes for arches, patio and French doors

lines.name: Palm Beach Polysatin Shutters
lines.summary: Palm Beach shutters are made from a Polysatin vinyl compound with internal aluminum bracing. They are built for strong sun and humidity, which makes them a common choice for bathrooms and hot rooms.
features: Palm Beach Promise against warping, cracking and fading

lines.name: NewStyle Hybrid Shutters
lines.summary: NewStyle shutters combine the look of painted wood with a more durable composite material. They are meant for busy households where shutters see a lot of use.

lines.name: Carole Fabrics Custom Drapery
lines.summary: Custom drapery and side panels made by Carole Fabrics and sold through Hunter Douglas dealers. They come in pleated, non-pleated and Ripplefold styles and can be stationary or fully operable.
features: Stationary side panels or working drapery
Large fabric selection with decorative trims

lines.name: PowerView Automation
lines.summary: PowerView Automation is Hunter Douglas's motorization system for shades, blinds, shutters and drapery. Shades can be run from a remote, the PowerView app, set schedules, or a voice assistant.
features: PowerView app for schedules and scenes
Works with Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant

lines.name: Honeycomb Shades
lines.summary: Alta's honeycomb (cellular) shades trap air in their cells to help insulate windows. They come in several cell sizes and a wide range of fabrics and opacities, including vertical versions for sliding doors.
features: Cordless, PowerWand, BLISS or Somfy motorized control

lines.name: Roller Shades
lines.summary: Alta roller shades give a clean, simple look with fabrics from sheer to room darkening. The line also includes a panel-track version for sliding doors and wide windows.
features: Wide range of fabrics, colors and opacities
Cordless, TouchLift cordless and continuous loop controls

lines.name: Banded Shades
lines.summary: Banded (also called dual or zebra) shades layer alternating solid and sheer stripes. Aligning the bands blocks light and gives privacy, while offsetting them lets filtered light through.
features: Cordless, continuous loop, PowerWand or motorized control

lines.name: Sheer Shadings
lines.summary: Sheer shadings hang soft fabric vanes between two sheer panels. Tilting the vanes moves the shade from a filtered view to full privacy, and Alta says its fabrics avoid the wavy moiré effect.
features: Cordless, retractable wand or continuous loop

lines.name: Natural Woven Shades
lines.summary: These handmade shades are woven from natural fibers such as grasses, woods and bamboo. Each one varies a little in color and texture, and liners can be added for privacy or light control.
features: Grass, woven wood and bamboo materials

lines.name: Wood Blinds
lines.summary: Alta wood blinds are made from premium woods in a range of stains, paints and textures. They suit most decor and give good light blocking.
features: Real wood in stains and paints
Cordless, Cordless Lift & Lock and Cordless XL lift
Wood or faux wood cornices and several valance styles

lines.name: Faux Wood Blinds
lines.summary: Faux wood blinds are made from an engineered polymer that looks like wood but resists moisture, cracking, chipping and fading. They are an affordable option for kitchens, baths and other humid rooms.
features: Solid colors or premium wood-grain finish
Cordless, Cordless Lift & Lock and Cordless XL lift

lines.name: Vertical Blinds
lines.summary: Alta vertical blinds cover sliding glass doors and tall windows while keeping the door easy to use. Vanes come in easy-clean vinyl, S-curve and fabric styles.

lines.name: Aluminum Blinds
lines.summary: Alta aluminum (mini) blinds are an inexpensive, durable choice for kitchens, mudrooms and laundry rooms. Their spring-tempered slats resist dents and moisture.

lines.name: Custom Shutters
lines.summary: Alta offers interior shutters in three materials. Polyresin Eclipse shutters resist moisture, wood shutters are made from natural hardwoods, and composite shutters are the budget-friendly, low-maintenance option.
features: Eclipse polyresin shutters for humid rooms

lines.name: Motorized Blinds and Shades
lines.summary: Alta's motorization program lets most of its shades and blinds be raised, lowered or tilted by remote, phone, schedule or voice. Two systems are offered, Alta's own BLISS Automation and Somfy Automation.
features: BLISS Automation with rechargeable wire-free motors
Somfy Zigbee motors with the TaHoma by Somfy app
Voice control with Alexa, Google Home or Siri
No cords, for pet and child safety

lines.name: Cellular Shades
lines.summary: Graber's honeycomb shades trap air in their cells to insulate the window and help with energy costs. Fabrics run from sheer to blackout, and vertical versions cover patio and sliding doors.
features: Cell sizes from 3/8 inch to 1 1/4 inch, single or double cell
Sheer, semi-sheer, light-filtering and blackout fabrics
Cordless, continuous loop or motorized lift

lines.name: Roller Shades
lines.summary: Graber roller shades have a clean, modern look with fabrics from sheer to blackout. A fabric-wrapped flat valance is available for a more finished top.

lines.name: Solar Shades
lines.summary: Solar shades use an open-weave fabric that cuts heat, glare and UV while keeping the view outside. Different openness levels balance daylight and privacy.
features: Fabrics from recycled ocean plastic or with antimicrobial protection
UltraLite cordless, continuous loop or motorized lift

lines.name: Classic Roman Shades
lines.summary: Classic Roman shades have crisp folds and neutral fabrics for a tailored look in almost any room. Fabrics come in sheer, light-filtering and room-darkening versions.
features: Cordless, continuous loop or motorized lift

lines.name: Tailored Roman Shades
lines.summary: Tailored Roman shades are Graber's premium fabric shades, hand-tailored in the U.S. from high-end fabrics and patterns. They can be matched to Graber custom drapery.
features: Classic Flat, Looped, Relaxed, Balloon and Seamless styles

lines.name: Natural Woven Wood Shades
lines.summary: These shades are handwoven from natural materials such as jute, bamboo, wood and grasses. Light-filtering or blackout liners can be added, and matching drapes and sliding panels are available.
features: Jute, bamboo, wood and grass weaves
Cordless, continuous loop or motorized lift
Matching Natural Drapes and Sliding Panels

lines.name: Layered (Zebra) Shades
lines.summary: Layered shades alternate sheer and opaque fabric bands. Moving the shade lines the bands up for filtered light or offsets them for privacy, and it can roll fully into the cassette.
features: UltraLite cordless, continuous loop or motorized lift

lines.name: Sheer Shades (Soft Blinds)
lines.summary: Graber's sheer shades, which it also calls soft blinds, combine soft fabric vanes with the tilting control of a blind. The fabric is woven as one seamless piece and retracts into a fabric-wrapped cassette.
features: Cordless, continuous loop or motorized lift

lines.name: Pleated Shades
lines.summary: Pleated shades have crisp, even pleats in a wide range of colors and patterns. Privacy or room-darkening liners can be added, and EvenPleat construction helps prevent sagging.

lines.name: Sliding Panels
lines.summary: Sliding panels are wide fabric panels on a track for large windows and patio doors. They share fabrics with Graber's Roman, natural, roller and solar shades for a coordinated look.
features: Suited to patio doors and wide windows
Fabrics shared with other Graber shades
Can be used as room dividers or closet doors

lines.name: Exterior Solar Shades
lines.summary: Outdoor solar shades block sun and heat on porches and patios before it reaches the house. They are built to stand up to weather and still leave a view outside.
features: Bottom notch keeps the shade from flapping

lines.name: Wood Blinds
lines.summary: Graber wood blinds are made from sustainably harvested North American basswood in a full range of paints and stains. Custom colors can be matched to trim or cabinets.
features: Traditions and Elite wood blind collections
Cordless and other lift and tilt controls

lines.name: Composite and Faux Wood Blinds
lines.summary: These blinds give a wood look in materials that resist moisture, warping, fading and peeling, so they work in kitchens, laundry rooms and baths. Composite blinds share colors with Graber composite shutters.
features: Faux wood (PVC) or lighter composite slats
Upgraded cordless lift with ergonomic bottom rail

lines.name: Vertical Blinds
lines.summary: Graber vertical blinds are an affordable way to control light on wide windows and patio doors. They come in fabric, machine-washable sheer and vinyl vanes.
features: Fabric, sheer and vinyl (crown or S-shaped) vanes
G71 headrail keeps vanes evenly spaced
Coordinates with roller, pleated and vinyl blinds

lines.name: Vinyl Blinds
lines.summary: Vinyl horizontal blinds with 2-inch slats are a lightweight, easy-clean option. They come in many colors, textures and patterns.
features: Range of colors, textures and patterns

lines.name: Aluminum Blinds
lines.summary: Aluminum blinds and mini blinds are a budget-friendly, durable choice for precise light control. Their painted slats resist dust, stains, scratches, mold and mildew.
features: Coated slats resist dust, stains and mildew

lines.name: Wood Shutters
lines.summary: Graber wood shutters are hand-crafted from 100% North American hardwood and can be finished in custom colors to match cabinets or trim. They are lighter than composite shutters, which helps on large windows.
features: Double-hung, arch, French door, cafe and bypass track options

lines.name: Composite Shutters
lines.summary: Composite shutters give the look of painted wood in an engineered material that will not warp, crack or peel in humid rooms. Panels can be up to 36 inches wide.
features: Improved one-way closure for light control
Nine frame styles; colors match composite blinds

lines.name: Custom Fabric Drapery
lines.summary: Graber custom drapery is hand-crafted in a range of fabrics, including linens, patterned sheers and velvets. It adds privacy, light control, insulation and sound softening, and can be matched to Tailored Roman shades.
features: Linen, sheer and velvet fabric options
Sewn-in liners, mitered corners and weighted hems

lines.name: Natural Drapes
lines.summary: Natural drapes are woven from renewable materials such as bamboo, reeds, grass and jute. They suit wide windows and patio doors and can match Graber natural shades.
features: Bamboo, reed, grass and jute weaves
Same materials as Natural Woven Shades

lines.name: Valances and Cornices
lines.summary: Graber offers custom valances, cornices, swags and cascades to finish the top of a window treatment. Craftsman wood valances and cornices give a more modern look.
features: Wood valances in a range of colors

lines.name: Drapery Hardware
lines.summary: Graber sells metal and wood drapery rods with a choice of finishes and finials, including larger sizes for heavy drapery. The motorized Glydea drapery track opens and closes drapes by remote, phone or voice.
features: Metal and wood rods with many finials and finishes
Larger rod sizes for heavy drapes

lines.name: Graber Motorization
lines.summary: Graber motorized shades can be controlled from a phone app, a remote or a motorized wand, and set to run on schedules. With a gateway they connect to smart-home systems and can be operated away from home.
features: App & Gateway control for Android and iOS
Motorized wand on Cellular, Pleated, Solar and Roller shades
Works with Alexa, Google and Control4 (gateway required)
Available on drapery as well as shades

lines.name: Soft Shades (Roman Shades)
lines.summary: Carole's soft shades are custom fabric Roman shades in six fold styles, from crisp flat folds to relaxed slouch styles. Several styles offer cordless or motorized lift, and the shade can sit forward of or behind the headrail.
features: Flat, Front Fold, Hobbled, Reverse Fold, Slouch and Soft Roman styles
Cordless and motorized lift on several styles

lines.name: Custom Draperies
lines.summary: Carole's custom draperies come in pleated and non-pleated header styles and can be stationary side panels or working, traversing drapery. They can be paired with shades and top treatments and motorized with suitable hardware.
features: 13 header styles across pleated and non-pleated
Sheer, light-filtering and room-darkening fabrics or linings

lines.name: Ripplefold Drapery
lines.summary: Ripplefold drapery hangs in soft, even waves by snapping onto carriers in a track. It is a traversing style and pairs well with motorization.
features: Snaps onto carriers in a track

lines.name: EZ Panel Program
lines.summary: The EZ Panel Program is a simplified way to order custom drapery panels by choosing a header, width and length. It draws on the full decorative fabric range and comes with light-filtering lining as standard.
features: Five header styles (four pleated, one grommet)

lines.name: Faux Romans
lines.summary: A faux Roman is a stationary treatment that looks like a raised Roman shade. It adds color and texture at the top of the window, is fully lined, and mounts inside or outside the frame.

lines.name: Top Treatments
lines.summary: Carole makes custom cornices, valances and swags to finish a window on their own or over shades and drapery. There are 32 styles to choose from.

lines.name: Pillows and Shams
lines.summary: Custom decorative pillows and pillow shams can be made in the same fabrics and trims as the window treatments. That makes it easy to coordinate a whole room.
features: Oblong and square pillows with zipper closure
Standard, Queen, King and Euro sham sizes
Same fabrics and trims as drapery

lines.name: Drapery Hardware
lines.summary: Carole offers drapery rods and tracks from several hardware brands to go with its draperies and panels. The range covers traditional and contemporary, stationary and motorized hardware, and many collections come in sets.

lines.name: Motorization
lines.summary: Traversing drapery and Roman shade lift systems from Carole can be motorized. Carole highlights three programs, Hunter Douglas PowerView, Alta BLISS 2.0 and AMP.
features: Motorized Roman shades and drapery hardware

lines.name: Draper at Home Residential Shades
lines.summary: Draper at Home is Draper's grouping of the shades suited to houses. It pulls together cordless, battery, rechargeable, Zigbee and hardwired FlexStyle and FlexShade models plus skylight and outdoor ZIP shades.
features: Skylight (TESS) and solar-powered outdoor ZIP shades

lines.name: FlexStyle Roller Shades
lines.summary: FlexStyle is Draper's design-focused roller shade, available as an open roll with decorative brackets or in a pre-assembled cassette. It comes in manual, cordless and many motorized versions for high-end homes and offices.
features: Open-roll with decorative brackets or cassette
Battery, rechargeable, Zigbee, RTS, low-voltage and AC motors

lines.name: Motorized FlexShade Roller Shades
lines.summary: FlexShade is Draper's core motorized roller shade for commercial and residential projects. Versions range from battery and rechargeable units that need no wiring to networked AC and low-voltage systems, plus extra-wide models such as FlexShade XL and Colossal.
features: Battery, rechargeable, low-voltage and line-voltage motors
Built-in RTS radio or Zigbee options
Single, dual, coupled and cassette hardware
Very wide shade options (XL, FlexShade 2, Colossal)

lines.name: Manual and Cordless Roller Shades
lines.summary: Draper's manual roller shades range from basic spring and clutch-and-chain shades to cordless UpLift and Elevate models that lift with a touch. Crank and twin-pull versions cover high or hard-to-reach windows.
features: Clutch and chain, spring roller and crank operation
Single, dual, coupled and cassette hardware

lines.name: Skylight and Tension Shades
lines.summary: These shades cover skylights, sloped glass and other angled glazing. TESS systems hold the fabric under tension at any angle, and Skylight FlexShade models come in manual and motorized versions.
features: TESS 140 tensioned shading at any angle
Topspin retractable panels for large glazed areas

lines.name: Outdoor and Exterior Shades
lines.summary: Draper's exterior shades block sun and heat before it reaches the glass, and ZIP models with side channels can enclose porches and patios against sun, wind, rain and insects. Some ZIP models charge from a solar panel.
features: FlexShade ZIP and ZIP XL with side channels
Tension ZIP for pergolas and angled roofs

lines.name: Specialty Shades
lines.summary: The specialty range covers unusual windows and light needs. It includes bottom-up and gabled shades for angled or tall glass, LightBloc systems for near or full blackout, dual-roller shades, and panel track for sliding doors.
features: Bottom-up and gabled shades for angled windows
LightBloc and LightBloc ZIP for blackout
Dual roller (two fabrics in one headbox)
Panel track and fixed shade panels

lines.name: Digitally Printed FlexShade
lines.summary: Digitally printed FlexShade puts images, graphics or logos on the shade fabric. It is mostly used in commercial interiors but can show any custom artwork.
features: Built on the FlexShade roller system

lines.name: IntelliFlex I/O Controls
lines.summary: IntelliFlex I/O is Draper's wired control network for motorized shades. Motors, wall switches, gateways and sensors share one network that also carries power, and it is set up from the devices themselves without a computer.
features: Up to 120 devices on one network
